purpose: Decker shield wave, cloak swirl, reveal and gang overcharge effects
prompt: Create one production-ready sprite animation sheet for Bullets of Fury, a detailed 16-bit arcade vertical shooter. Transparent RGBA background, no scenery, NO lettering, no frames, no checkerboard. Exactly 6 columns by 4 rows, 24 evenly spaced square cells in a landscape 1536x1024 canvas; every effect centered in its own 256px cell with generous 20px clear gutters, no neighboring-cell overlap. Sharp authored pixel-art clusters and bright shaded arcade energy, not vector lines, no solid flat discs. Row 1: six chronological frames of Decker's experimental shield wave: intricate icy cyan/chrome concentric energy ring expanding from small to large, hollow clear center, pixel sparks trailing outward, final ring fading. Row 2: six seamless loop frames of a clockwise swirling cyan/turquoise cloak cocoon: two or three beautiful curved energy ribbons forming a hollow circular vortex around an invisible spaceship, chrome-white highlights, enough transparent center to see the ship, consistent scale and center. Row 3: six chronological frames of cloak breaking/reveal: cyan and magenta electric ribbons peeling away from a hollow ring, bright little shards and sparks, first coherent then disintegrating into separated small flecks, clear center throughout. Row 4: six seamless loop frames of chrome-white overcharge aura: intricate silver-white electrical plasma tongues outlining a rounded invisible ship silhouette, hollow inside, distinct mirrored sweeping wisps, small bright prismatic highlights, suitable for game palette swaps. Each row is one cohesive animation, progressive movement left to right, same viewpoint, crisp readable silhouette at 80px. No ships or characters inside effects; transparent pixels everywhere outside authored glow.
